roles.enabledDesc: Lets you define tailored roles and assign them to accounts. Permissions stay in force even when this is off.
roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.description: Define what each kind of account can do. Only the super admin authors roles; administrators assign them.
roles.name: Name
roles.confirmDelete: Delete this role? It must be unassigned first.
roles.inUse: Cannot delete: {count} accounts still hold it.
roles.slugExists: A role with that name already exists ({name}).
roles.locked: This is a system role: it cannot be renamed or deleted.
roles.notAssignable: You cannot assign a role holding more permissions than you do.
roles.superAdminOnly: Only a super admin can assign this role.
roles.memberPinned: Every account holds the Member role permanently.
roles.rolesRequired: At least one role must be assigned.
roles.lastSuperAdmin: The last super admin cannot be removed.

read.label: View members
read.description: Read member records, their contact details, and export them.

write.label: Edit members
write.description: Create, edit, suspend or cancel members and their data.

approve.label: Approve registrations
approve.description: Accept or reject pending membership requests.

read.label: View types and groups
read.description: Read membership types and club groups.

write.label: Edit types and groups
write.description: Create and edit membership types and groups.

read.label: View activities
read.description: Read every activity, including drafts and archived ones.

write.label: Edit activities
write.description: Create and edit activities, prices, modalities and consents.

publish.label: Publish activities
publish.description: Publish, archive or cancel an activity. Without it, only drafts can be prepared.

read.label: View registrations
read.description: Read and export any member's or activity's registrations.

write.label: Manage registrations
write.description: Change a registration's status, cancel it, or promote from the waitlist.

read.label: View billing
read.description: Read receipts, concepts, mandates and remittances, and download their PDFs.

write.label: Edit billing
write.description: Emit, settle, void or return receipts, and manage mandates and remittances.

run.label: Run bulk billing
run.description: Generate fees across the whole club at once. An exceptional action.

read.label: View communications
read.description: Read announcements, their audience and their stats.

write.label: Draft communications
write.description: Create and edit announcements without sending them.

send.label: Send communications
send.description: Send an announcement to its audience. Cannot be undone.

read.label: View bookings
read.description: Read spaces, zones, slots and all bookings.

write.label: Manage bookings
write.description: Create and edit spaces and slots, and book or cancel on anyone's behalf.

read.label: View reports
read.description: Read the club's annual totals. Aggregates only — it opens no individual record.

write.label: Edit notes and reminders
write.description: Create, edit and complete internal notes and reminders.

read.label: View settings
read.description: Read the organisation's details and configuration.

write.label: Edit settings
write.description: Change club details, logo, address and which features are enabled.

write.label: Edit profile fields
write.description: Define which custom fields exist on member records.

write.label: Edit integrations
write.description: Configure SSO, outgoing mail and payment providers. Reserved to the super admin because it exposes credentials.

read.label: View accounts
read.description: Read user accounts and the roles assigned to them.

write.label: Manage accounts
write.description: Assign or remove roles and activate or deactivate accounts.

read.label: View roles
read.description: Read the defined roles and which permissions each one holds.

write.label: Author roles
write.description: Create, edit and delete roles. Reserved to the super admin: whoever authors roles can grant any permission.

read.label: View own profile
read.description: Read one's own record and contact details.

write.label: Edit own profile
write.description: Change one's own details and profile photo.

read.label: View the catalogue
read.description: Read published activities and their prices in order to register.

read.label: View own registrations
read.description: Read which activities one is registered for, and their documents.

write.label: Register for activities
write.description: Sign up for an activity, cancel one's own registration and upload documents.

read.label: View own receipts
read.description: Read and download one's own receipts and bank mandate.

write.label: Pay own receipts
write.description: Change one's own payment method and pay a receipt online.

read.label: View own card
read.description: Read and download one's own membership card.

read.label: View own bookings
read.description: Read available spaces and one's own bookings.

write.label: Make bookings
write.description: Book a space and cancel one's own bookings.

read.label: View own notifications
read.description: Read one's notifications and received announcements.

write.label: Mark notifications read
write.description: Mark one's own notifications as read.
